title: 영양제 라벨 읽기: 하루에 몇 번, 몇 정 먹어요?
objective: You can read a Korean supplement label and find the times per day, tablets each time, before or after meals, storage, and use-by date.
summary: Learners read a Korean supplement label to find how often and how much to take it, how to store it, and the use-by date.
note: The label above is a made-up example. The product name and numbers are not real.

task.title: Read and find information
task.line: Read each short label or situation and write the answer the question asks for.

sections.heading: The label: 하루온 비타민C
paragraphs: [주의 사항] 임산부, 어린이는 섭취 전에 의사와 상담하십시오. 몸에 이상이 있으면 섭취를 멈추십시오.
[보관 방법] 햇빛을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이 손에 닿지 않게 하십시오.

sections.heading: Words to find on the label

items.text: It shows how many times you take it in one day.
It shows how much you take at one time.
It is a counter for pills; capsules use 캡슐.
This part tells you how often and when to take it.
items.example: 처음 사면 섭취 방법부터 읽어 보세요.

items.text: Take it after eating; 식전 means before a meal.
It lists who should be careful and when to stop.
items.example: 임신 중이면 주의 사항을 꼭 보세요.

items.text: It tells you where and how to keep the product.
items.example: 여름에는 보관 방법을 잘 지켜야 해요.

items.text: It is the last day you can safely take it.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Count the total: 1일 2회, 1회 2정 means 2 × 2 = 4 tablets a day. 60정 (60일분) means one bottle lasts 60 days.

exercises: Read the label and answer with numbers: 「오메가3 / 1일 2회, 1회 1캡슐 / 내용량: 60캡슐」 ① How many capsules do you take in a day? ② How many days does one bottle last?
Choose 식전 or 식후 for each instruction: ① 밥을 먹기 전에 드세요. ② 저녁을 다 먹고 드세요.
The label says 「습기가 없는 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.」 (습기 = humidity, 서늘하다 = cool). Is each place OK? Write Yes or No: ① 샤워하는 욕실 ② 거실 서랍 안 ③ 한여름 자동차 안
Today is 2026년 10월 12일. Can you still take it? Write Yes or No: ① 소비기한: 2026.09.30까지 ② 소비기한: 2027.03.15까지
Which part of the label do you read? Write the Korean heading: ① 하루에 몇 번 먹어요? ② 어디에 둬요? ③ 언제까지 먹을 수 있어요?
answers: ① No ② Yes ③ No
① 섭취 방법 ② 보관 방법 ③ 소비기한
